Hook: AI drafts. You decide. The customer asks: Can you promise it will be ready by Friday? The sentences of the AI's first draft that get edited appear word for word, cuts marked with ellipses, then a person's three edits play as tracked changes, struck AI words and added human words. Edit 1, tone: a generic thanks and the [Your Name] placeholder become a personal thanks and the owner's name. Edit 2, fact: the AI said a 20% off deal applies; the person notes the deal ended in September. Edit 3, promise: the AI promised the bike by Friday; the person writes that tune-ups take 3 to 5 business days, so they can't promise Friday. Rule: make it sound like you, check every fact, cut promises you can't keep. Ends on Put AI to work in your business, the 90-Day AI Launch, ka-performancefl.com/ai-launch, or call Alex 904-210-1071.
